title.zh: Crypto Scammers Who Used Prayer Groups to Lure Victims Must Pay $1.3 Billion, Says New York
title.en: Crypto Scammers Who Used Prayer Groups to Lure Victims Must Pay $1.3 Billion, Says New York

current_state.zh: New York Attorney General Letitia James asked a court to order NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion and related entities to pay about $1.37 billion after they defaulted and fled the U.S., while four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million and were banned from the securities, commodities, and crypto industries over a scheme that targeted Haitian communities through prayer groups and WhatsApp.
